<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F8FA"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(308,16)">
      <rect x="0" y="8" width="18" height="10" rx="2.7" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>
      <rect x="2" y="10" width="14" height="6" rx="1.3" fill="#050505" opacity="0.85"/>
      <rect x="19" y="11" width="1.5" height="4" fill="#050505" opacity="0.4"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(333,18)">
      <circle cx="4" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
      <circle cx="8" cy="7" r="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="3" r="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(357,16)">
      <rect x="0" y="7" width="12" height="8" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <line x1="3" y1="3.5" x2="9" y2="3.5" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="1" y1="5.2" x2="1" y2="11.8" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <line x1="11" y1="5.2" x2="11" y2="11.8" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- App header -->
  <text x="26" y="112" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#050505">Hello Again!</text>
  <text x="26" y="144" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Welcome back, you’ve been missed.</text>

  <!-- Decorative top info card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="164" width="342" height="72" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <rect x="26" y="166" width="342" height="72" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="200" r="18" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="54" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">N</text>
    <text x="84" y="192" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">Morning briefing</text>
    <text x="84" y="212" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Sign in to catch today’s top stories and saved topics.</text>
    <rect x="285" y="182" width="64" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="317" y="201" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="272" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Username or email</text>
    <rect x="24" y="282" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g transform="translate(36,294)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="24" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
    <text x="70" y="312" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">jordan.lee@newsmail.com</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="372" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="382" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="40" y="399" width="12" height="12" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="41.5" y1="405" x2="50.5" y2="405" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="70" y="412" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">••••••••••••</text>
    <g transform="translate(332,396)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.8" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="4" y1="20" x2="20" y2="4" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- remember me / forgot link -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="452" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="29,464 33,468 40,458" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="58" y="469" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Remember me</text>
    <text x="232" y="469" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Login button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="500" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="531" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Login</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="587" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">or continue with</text>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="606" width="165" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="630" r="11" fill="#18ACFE"/>
    <path d="" fill="none"/>
    <text x="72" y="636" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="606" width="165" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="630" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="221,626 229,626 231,629 228,633 221,633 219,629" fill="#4285F4"/>
    <polygon points="229,626 234,628 232,632 228,633" fill="#EB4335"/>
    <polygon points="221,633 228,633 230,636 225,639 219,635" fill="#34A853"/>
    <polygon points="219,629 221,633 219,635 216,632 216,630" fill="#FBBC05"/>
    <text x="249" y="636" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Sign up prompt -->
  <text x="195" y="702" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Don’t have an account? <tspan font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Sign Up</tspan></text>

  <!-- Trust / benefits cards -->
  <text x="24" y="744" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">Why sign in?</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="754" width="342" height="46" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="777" r="14" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <polyline points="40,777 44,781 52,771" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="772" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">Saved topics</text>
    <text x="72" y="789" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Bookmark stories and follow writers you care about.</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="808" width="342" height="34" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="825" r="11" fill="#F4B740"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="820" x2="46" y2="826" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="829" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="72" y="830" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Get instant alerts for breaking news and updates.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g transform="translate(30,780)">
      <polygon points="16,4 24,10 24,22 8,22 8,10" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="12" y="14" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="16" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(112,780)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="12" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="21" y1="17" x2="27" y2="23" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(194,780)">
      <rect x="8" y="6" width="16" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="11" x2="20" y2="11" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="20" y2="16" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(276,780)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="12" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="12" r="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="16" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Minimal shadow / bar -->
  <rect x="24" y="500" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
</svg>
